answer_1.quote: Translation is an open-ended task ... The ability to produce non-literal, more natural translations is one of the goals in the field of Machine Translation (MT).

answer_2.quote: To measure similarity amongst hypotheses and against the reference(s), we experiment with the following standard MT evaluation metrics: sentBLEU, TER, ChrF, Meteor, BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: Human judgements were given by professional translators ... The annotators were asked to rate each sentence from 0-100 according to the perceived translation quality.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each translation on a 0-100 scale, with defined ranges indicating quality levels (e.g., 0-10 incorrect, 11-29 few correct keywords, ..., 90-100 perfect).
